sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Pages with sub-tables: a global filter that matches nothing no longer hides every sub-table. When it would empty all of them, they all stay on screen showing "(0 of N)", as before 9.99.1338, so the buttons in their column headers stay reachable. Example: on a release, "11.666" typed into the global filter while lengths are shown in seconds hid the only medium, and with it the ⏱ button that switches to the milliseconds that would have matched. Sub-tables are still hidden while at least one keeps a matching row.
